ui-commands.compact.done: ✓ Context compacted. The conversation has a note of it too.
ui-commands.compact.doneSizes: ✓ Context compacted: {before} → {after} tokens{took}. The conversation has a note of it too, and the context ring is updated.
ui-commands.compact.intro: The Agent's own /compact compacts this session's context (while online, in this session's process); it may use model allowance. When it finishes, the conversation gets a note with the size before and after.
ui-commands.config.intro: Edit the native config as JSON; it is saved in its original format and the old version is backed up. Secrets show as placeholders. A host-login profile is read-only.
ui-commands.config.label: Native config JSON
ui-commands.export.intro: The full session includes tool input and output and file paths; choose carefully whom you share it with.
ui-commands.ext.warning: Adding an extension may run programs the extension provides. Check the name and config; only a profile signed in separately here can be changed.
ui-commands.fork.intro: Creates a new session with the same native context; this session is kept.
ui-commands.help.intro: Common actions run right here. Refresh to read the Skills and commands actually available on this execution machine.
ui-commands.identity.noOthers: No other Claude Code profile yet.
ui-commands.identity.slotsHint: Claude Code and its subagents pick models by slot name. Leave empty for Claude Code's own default; a GLM profile, for example, can set opus to glm-5.3[1m].
ui-commands.identity.slotsSaved: Saved this profile's model slots. Sessions using it restart the Claude process at their next message and continue the conversation (running background tasks and timers end).
ui-commands.identity.switchHint: Switch to another of your Claude Code profiles (for example another GLM account or the official subscription); the history and context are kept. You can switch once this turn ends.
ui-commands.identity.switched: Switched to "{profile}". From the next message this conversation continues with the new profile; the model chosen for this session alone is cleared.
ui-commands.mcp.invalid: The MCP config must be valid JSON
ui-commands.mcp.name: Server name
ui-commands.model.catalogHint: After reading the native model list, the reasoning efforts (such as ultra) and Fast the chosen model supports are shown.
ui-commands.model.label: Model
ui-commands.model.placeholder: Leave empty for the native default
ui-commands.model.saved: Changed for this session only; takes effect from the next turn. {more}
ui-commands.model.savedLive: While online, the next turn switches directly without restarting the AI process (background tasks and subagents keep running; an older CLI version restarts the process and continues this conversation).
ui-commands.model.scope: Affects only this session's later turns; the profile's defaults stay as they are. {current}
ui-commands.op.background: The operation is still running in the background; check back later. It will not be redone automatically.
ui-commands.op.stopped: The operation stopped; see the activity trace
ui-commands.palette.hint: Commands · ↑ ↓ to choose · Enter to open · Esc to close
ui-commands.palette.none: No matching command. Use /help to refresh the native commands, or /terminal to open the full CLI.
ui-commands.permissions.saved: Later turns use the new settings; turns already started keep the old ones. {more}
ui-commands.permissions.savedLive: An online AI process switches at the next turn without a restart (turning "skip all permission prompts" on or off, changing the Codex sandbox, or an older CLI version still restarts the process and continues the conversation).
ui-commands.permissions.scope: Applies to this profile's later turns; other sessions using the same profile follow it too. {current}
ui-commands.pick: Choose an action from the command menu.
ui-commands.plugins.name: Plugin name / ID
ui-commands.review.intro: Codex reviews the uncommitted changes in the working folder; it may use model allowance.
ui-commands.skills.name: Skill name
ui-commands.skills.save: Save skill (keeps a backup of the old one)
ui-commands.skills.writeTitle: Create or update a Skill of a separate profile
ui-commands.stop.button: Stop the current run and queued messages
ui-commands.title: Commands
